instructions:
发布会条目须用coveredFactIds登记正文或简讯实际覆盖的showcaseFacts；同一页面、同一游戏不等于全部事实已覆盖。只有存在会改变正文事实边界的实质证据缺口才继续needs_review，不因热度或预算排除，也不要把needs_review当作默认保守选项。
输出 contractVersion=2。你是游戏行业简报编辑；事件事实仅来自已打开的 packet 证据。对 packages 和 trackingQueue 每个 eventKey 恰好给一个 include/exclude/needs_review。needs_review 必须 tracking=true；跟踪项无新证据也须明确继续或关闭，关闭时 tracking=false 且 reason 写依据。
从 automation/status/<edition-id>.json 原样复制 packet.blobSha 到 packetBlobSha；不得使用可变分支 HEAD。publishability=requires_subject_identity 只能 exclude/needs_review，不得从标题虚构 titleKey/titleEn。
若 packet.continuation.scope=news，这是受信的同一期有界续接包：只处理本包 packages/trackingQueue，保留已发布正文、标题、头条和 issue/window，不提交 upcoming 变更，不添加 showcaseRefs、其他批次或窗口外事实。若 scope=showcase，严格按 scoped announcement/fact 身份补齐，不把普通新闻混入，也不因部分材料或 Highlights 声称完整。
lane=interviews、features、industry、reviews、awards 可按文章/采访/评测/分析/奖项信息本身首次发布的时间准入，但必须有明确的信息增量（首次披露、独立采访、调查、技术/产业分析、正式评分或奖项变化）。普通观点、推荐、促销软文、无新增信息的旧闻复述仍应 exclude。不得把窗口外旧事件伪装成窗口内 breaking news；标题摘要须体现本次新增内容。
证据门槛按最终 factStatus 判断，不按来源数量机械升级：official 要求已打开一手来源；单一已打开、注册为 media 的可信媒体，只要主体、窗口和核心事实清楚，就可以 media_report 发布，不得仅因“只有一家媒体”或 readiness=single-media 而 needs_review；可信媒体明确转述可识别的官方公告、采访或发言时，可以 media_relay_official，verification 写清转述链。multi_source_verified 才要求两家独立可靠来源。readiness 只描述证据组成，不是发布资格。未确认但具有新闻价值且来源边界清楚的内容可进 rumors，factStatus=unconfirmed、tracking=true，并在标题摘要保留不确定性；只有主体身份未解、来源互相冲突、固定窗口无法确认、动态聚合数据缺少所需快照等实质阻塞才使用 needs_review。A级也不豁免时间/来源要求。中英文新闻标题和archiveTitle须自带明确的游戏、公司或人物主语，离开上方主体栏仍能独立理解。中文直述具体事实，verification 说明证据边界，不用宣传套话。
每个 include 决定必须填写完整 sharedFactFrame，作为两种语言共用的事实边界；subjectTitleKey/platforms 必须与最终 Canonical 决定一致，日期、时刻、数字、人物机构、版本专名只能来自所选证据，不得新增。
中文游戏名依次查 config/title-translations.json、editorialInput.titleHints，仍缺才做 title-only open-web lookup。优先官方简中，其次已查证广泛使用的 common_translation；否则保留原名，titleZhCn=null、titleZhStatus=unavailable。禁止机翻/自造名称。有官方大陆简中渠道的游戏，版本、角色、职业、模式、机制等采用大陆官方术语。所有名称/术语查询仅规范名称，不得增加事件事实、时间、平台、发行信息、来源分类、tracking 或候选。
默认尝试完整 locales.en：在相同 include/sharedFactFrame 内独立写自然英文，优先英文一手证据正式专名；只有中文证据也不得扩充事实。entries 按 include 顺序以 eventKey 对应，upcoming 仅按 upcomingId 对应本次 patch，继承项不重复。headline/summary/verification/timeNote 必须完整英文，无中文 fallback；sourceReport 完整英文或 null，其余显示字段按需提供英文。
如果无法在事实边界内可靠完成完整英文稿，可以省略 locales.en；publisher 标记 unavailable，不能削弱中文 Canonical 来迁就英文。不要填写 factsDigest/canonicalCopyDigest/localeDigest 或猜最终 entryId，均由 trusted publisher 生成绑定。
archiveTitle 对应 period：日报｜、早报｜、晚报｜；英文对应 Daily Brief |、Morning Brief |、Evening Brief |。Daily 窗口为前日10:10 exclusive 至当日10:10 inclusive，plannedAt=当日12:00；10:10—12:00 新事实属于下一期，历史迁移窗口以 packet 为准。
早报 upcomingMode=replace 重建未来15天；晚报 inherit_and_patch。日报必须使用 upcomingMode=inherit_and_patch，不复制 upcomingBaseline.items；不要因为本次 packet 没有新的发售证据而提交空表覆盖历史。trusted publisher 继承 Canonical 基线并剔除当日及15天窗口外项。仅提交新增/变更 upcoming 或有证据支持延期取消的 removeUpcomingIds，必须有 HTTPS 来源。
upcomingBaseline.refreshRange 是 packet-only 的唯一日历例外：每天核验完整 startInclusive—endInclusive，不把旧期次当作已完成核验。打开开发商/发行商公告或 PlayStation/Nintendo/Xbox/Steam 官方页面；新查事实仅用于日历，不得改变新闻 packages/trackingQueue 决定、正文、时间、factStatus、来源分类或 tracking。无可靠来源不填充，不因发现失败删除条目。
upcomingDiscovery 仅是线索。优先 knownTitle、crossSource、inBaseline=false；采用前打开官方详情，核对完整游戏身份、日期、平台、地区和正式版/抢先体验/移植/DLC。日期冲突不可猜选，reviewLinks 是待阅读文章而非游戏项。对 PC/PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo 分别检查完整15天；coverage 为 failed/empty_or_changed、列表不全或 omittedCandidates>0 时针对补查，并在 sourceReport 记录实际检查和缺口，不得声称全量覆盖。

packages.headline: Celebrate Delta Force’s 2nd Anniversary With New Ways to Play, Exclusive Rewards, and More

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
Delta Force Game Director Shadow Guo shares how two years of player feedback shaped the new season, from a smoother path into each match to more ways to play across Operations and Warfare.
Celebrate Delta Force’s 2nd Anniversary With New Ways to Play, Exclusive Rewards, and More
An anniversary is a great checkpoint for a live game. It is a reason to celebrate, and a chance to look at how far the game has moved from the version first placed in players’ hands.
Delta Force began on PC, expanded to mobile a few months later, and arrived on XBOX Series X|S a little over a year ago. Each platform brought in new players, different habits, and a fresh set of expectations. Their feedback has continued to change how we build the game.
That last point comes up throughout our conversation. Depth matters to Delta Force , especially in Operations, where learning how to prepare, move, fight, and extract is part of the experience. Players also need a clearer way to learn that depth. Friction at the start affects new players, experienced Operators returning after time away, and anyone trying to bring a friend into their squad.
“We looked at the whole process,” he says. “Where are the players waiting? Where do new players get lost? What are experienced players repeating every time? Each one looks like a small problem, but together they take too much time away from playing.”
Then comes the loadout screen. One-click loadout prepares a recommended setup for the map ahead, using the player’s stash first and purchasing what is missing. If Tekniq Alloy runs short, the new Combat Support Fund can cover part of the difference within a set limit. Shadow describes the value in simple terms: “The important part is the time you get back. You can spend less time comparing attachments between every run.”
The same thinking shaped the new-player experience. A redesigned tutorial gives new Operators a clearer start, while the G.T.I. Field Manual keeps essential information inside the game and easy to revisit. These changes help players through their first match and make it easier for an existing player to bring a friend along.
Once players deploy, Shadow describes Reorientation through a different idea: pace. A run can hold pressure, recovery, exploration, and sudden escalation without asking players to stay at the same intensity for every minute. Layali Grove 2.0 shows the quieter side of that idea. The map extends farther along its river with new places to explore, while fishing gives squads a reason to pause between firefights. It has its own progression and map-specific catches, which can be displayed in the Collection Room aquarium. The river also becomes part of the action through a two-player jet ski and the new Breaking Wave bounty mission, which puts squads on an assault boat.
“Two years went faster than we expected,” Game Director Shadow Guo says. “At the beginning, our focus was simple: make a good shooter. Then players came in and played it in ways we had not planned for. They showed us where the game was strong, and where it was asking too much from them.”

packages.headline: Five Ways to Build a Better Used-Car Business in Used Cars Simulator

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
Key tips and a guide on your approach to selling and exploring in Used Cars Simulator.
Five Ways to Build a Better Used-Car Business in Used Cars Simulator
Buying a cheap car is easy. Figuring out whether it is actually a good deal takes a little more work.
In Used Cars Simulator , every vehicle can be an opportunity – or a collection of dents, missing parts, and unexpected expenses waiting to eat into your profit. Growing your business means learning which cars are worth your money, what needs fixing, and when it is better to walk away.
And that is only the business side. Outside the shed, there are quests to complete, places to explore, physics to experiment with, and a few considerably less respectable ways to acquire your next vehicle.
Whether you plan to become a careful car trader or embrace the unpredictable side of the sandbox, these five tips can help you get started.
The most important part of a profitable flip happens before the car belongs to you.
Take the time to check its condition, look for the damages and missing parts, and think about how much work it will take before the vehicle is ready to sell again. A low asking price does not automatically make something a bargain. The cheaper car may end up becoming the more expensive project once you start ordering parts and fixing everything you missed.
And do not forget to negotiate. Money saved before the car reaches your shed gives you more room for profit when it leaves.

Gears of War: E-Day x Liquid Death – Unlock a Legendary Pose and More
Starting September 25, unlock a Legendary Chainsaw Flex pose in Gears of War: E-Day — plus a limited-edition merch drop.
Gears of War: E-Day launches with a collab that puts a Legendary pose in your hands. We’re teaming up with Liquid Death from September 25 through November 30 , bringing an in-game reward, a limited-edition merch drop, and a new way to gear up for Emergence Day.
Pick up Liquid Death Energy at Amazon, Target, Walmart, Instacart, or Kroger and you can unlock an in-game content pack for Gears of War: E-Day , headlined by Chainsaw Flex — a Legendary animated pose you can equip on any playable character. Nothing says “I’m fine, everything’s fine” on Emergence Day quite like flexing with a Chainsaw.
To claim it, head to liquiddeath.com/freechainsaws , connect your retailer account through the digital reward landing page, then purchase Liquid Death Energy through that retailer online or in store. Offer runs in the U.S. only from September 25 – November 30, 2026.
Additionally, at 12pm PT today, the limited-edition Liquid Death x Gears of War: E-Day chainsaw pint glass drops for $25 at the Liquid Death Merch Store . Limited edition means limited edition. Move accordingly.

packages.headline: How Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Brings High Flying Drama to XBOX Series X|S

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
Few game franchises capture the fantasy of becoming an ace pilot quite like Ace Combat – with accessible arcade-like controls, beautiful looking fighter jets, and cinematic storytelling, it has long been a recipe for a good time for over 30 years. Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve returns us to that world of soaring spectacle starting October 2 for XBOX Series X|S with even deeper aircraft customization and more epic set pieces along with a squadron whose personalities bring added weight to every mission.
How Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Brings High Flying Drama to XBOX Series X|S
As you can tell by the trailer footage and screenshots, Ace Combat 8 is an incredible looking game. The work put into the new cloud layer tech really brings the sky to life, as well as the touches on the ground environments that show off some extraordinary attention to detail. Buildings and trees are easily identifiable, and the shape of the canyon terrain is impressive when flying through these large gameplay maps. Same goes for the interior and exterior of the carrier Endurance, your primary home base throughout the game, which shows its wear and tear with pride during the campaign as a floating island of refuge.
There are four main types of aircraft that you can acquire, and they each have a role to play on the missions: Fighters (combat), Multirole (versatile), Attacker (ground attack), and Electronic Warfare (buffer/support). You’re not wrong in thinking that sounds like a prime recipe for a good dungeon crawling party, as bringing a balanced, multi-role fighter group into the missions is one of the keys to success that I found.
Having now played through the first 10 campaign missions, I found them all incredibly fun and robust, giving you a mix of everything from escort missions, bombing runs, air-to-air combat, mixed in with some incredible set pieces like taking out a land battleship or protecting your fragile carrier fleet. Each mission has felt distinct and unique, with its own challenges to manage, and in-flight decision making that can help turn the tide of battle.
If you need help getting your bearings, Ace Combat 8 also offers a series of progressively challenging training missions to help you get used to the controls – personally, I’m pretty adept at these types of games, so I didn’t dabble too much into this feature, but I appreciate the work put in to make this game as accessible as possible to help newer pilots earn their wings.
That’s good because combat in Ace Combat 8 really tests your ability to understand some basic rules about dogfighting and air combat – it’s far more involved than simply pointing and shooting. Beyond the obvious (don’t hit the ground), being able to manage your aircraft’s speed and positioning to enemy aircraft is key to coming out on top, especially against some of the harder foes you face off with when it starts to feel like a chess match in the skies, trying to anticipate the enemy’s next move.
I also really liked the interactions with Joker Flight throughout my time with A ce Combat 8 , who helped bring an emotional weight to the storyline that feeds into each mission. There’s the patient veteran Professor, the spunky civilian-turned-pilot Tasha, and the reclusive musician Noise who are with you nearly every step of the way. They’re more than just chatter over the radio, as they’re all very capable shots helping take out objectives and to clear bogeys off my six.
Cinematic battles, tactical flexibility, and human drama work together to make this one of the series’ best entries.
But it’s the aircraft, as always, who are the stars of the show – and they’re just as impressive as ever. This game is truly a visual marvel, one that shines a light on the beautiful mechanical design of fighter jets, from the swept-wing F-14 Tomcat to the brash-but-beautiful A-10 Warthog.
